ADD_CANVAS_LAYER: Add a canvas: a shape to paint in
ADD_CANVAS_LAYER_WITH_SHORTCUT: Add a canvas: a shape to paint in ({shortcut} adds the kind added last)
ADD_IMAGE_LAYERS: Add images, or drop image files on the window
ADD_PATH_FROM_SVG_HINT: Import the shapes of SVG files (also by dropping them on the window)
ADD_SHAPE_LAYER_WITH_SHORTCUT: Add a shape layer ({shortcut} adds the kind added last)
ASPECT_RATIO_LOCKED: Aspect ratio locked: width and height change together. Click to unlock.
ASPECT_RATIO_UNLOCKED: Aspect ratio unlocked: width and height change separately. Click to lock.
BLEED_HINT: How far the artwork goes past the cut lines, so a cut slightly off the line leaves no blank edge: printed beyond the outline and into the holes
BROKEN_COLOR_LINK_HINT: Linked to the color variable {name}, which no longer exists: keeps its last color. Pick a color to unlink it, or add a color variable named {name} to link it again.
BROKEN_FIELD_LINK_HINT: Linked to {formula}, but there is no variable named {name} anymore: keeps its last value. Type a value, or click fx to change the formula or unlink it. A variable named {name} links it again.
BROKEN_TEXT_LINK_HINT: Linked to the text variable {name}, which no longer exists: keeps its last text. Click to pick another text variable or unlink it. A text variable named {name} links it again.
BRUSH_KIND_HINT: Click for its kinds: round (thinning out at both ends), calligraphy (a flat nib at an angle), marker (square ends, see-through), spray (scattered dots) or bristle (thin lines side by side, like a dry brush)
CANNOT_ALLOCATE_GROUP_BUFFER: Cannot allocate a {w} x {h} group buffer
CANNOT_APPLY_EFFECTS: Cannot apply the effects of a layer
CHANGE_SHORTCUT_HINT: Click, then press the new keys. Right-click to remove it.
CHANGE_VARIABLE_LINK_HINT: Linked: edit the formula, or unlink
CLICK_TO_UNLINK_COLOR: Linked: click to unlink, keeping the color
COLOR_LINKED_HINT: Linked to the color variable {name}: follows it when it changes. Pick another color to unlink it.
COLOR_VARIABLES_EMPTY: No color variables yet. A color picked from the color variables stays linked to it and follows when it changes.
COMMAND_ADD_CANVAS: Add a canvas of the kind added last
COMMAND_ADD_SHAPE: Add a shape of the kind added last
COMMAND_NUDGE: Nudge by 1 mm (10 mm with Shift)
CONFIRM_SAVE_BEFORE_CLOSING: Save the changes to "{name}" before closing?
CUT_PREVIEW_OPACITY_HINT: How much the cut preview covers: below 1, what will be cut out stays faintly visible on the canvas, under the hatching
DEFAULT_SHORTCUTS_IN_USE: Not given back, used by other commands: {shortcuts}.
DISTORT_LAYER_HINT:
On: drag each corner on its own to fake perspective.
Off: corners resize the image.
Holding Ctrl while dragging a corner swaps the two.
DRAW_LINE_HINT: Click to place both ends of the line, or press and drag to curve it. Esc to cancel.
DRAW_POINTS_HINT: Click to place a sharp point, or press and drag for a smooth one; a click on the first point closes the shape. Double-click, Enter or right-click to finish.
EDIT_POINTS_HINT: Drag the points on the canvas, and the handles of the picked point to curve its segments (Alt moves one handle on its own). Double-click a point to make it smooth or sharp, a segment to add a point there. {delete} removes the picked point and the arrow keys move it. Shift keeps 15° steps; Alt stops snapping. A double click on the shape also starts editing; Esc stops.
EFFECTS_INTRO: Effects change how the image looks without changing its file.
EFFECTS_ORDER_HINT: Applied top to bottom. Drag the dots to reorder.
EFFECT_BRIGHTNESS_CONTRAST_HINT: Lighten or darken, and increase or reduce contrast
EFFECT_DROP_SHADOW_HINT: A soft shadow cast behind the image, outside its edges too
EFFECT_FADE_LINEAR_HINT: Fade one side of the image to transparent
EFFECT_FADE_RADIAL_HINT: Fade the image to transparent around a center
EFFECT_HUE_SATURATION_HINT: Shift colors around the color wheel and change their intensity
EFFECT_OUTLINE_HINT: A line along the edge of the image's shape: its visible pixels
EFFECT_POSTERIZE_HINT: Reduce each channel to a few levels
EFFECT_TINT_HINT: Color the image with one color
ELEMENT_LINE_COLOR: Line color, on screen and in the export
EXPORT_CROP_MARKS_HINT: Short lines in line with the edges of the outline's box, outside the bleed, to line up the cut
EXPORT_LOW_RESOLUTION_ONE: {n} image prints at a low resolution
EXPORT_LOW_RESOLUTION_OTHER: {n} images print at a low resolution
EXPORT_MARKS_OFF_PAGE: Some marks fall off the page and will not be printed
EXPORT_MARKS_OFF_SHEETS: Some marks fall outside the sheets and will not be printed: move the sheets to cover them
EXPORT_MIN_IMAGE_DPI_HINT: Image layers printed at a lower resolution are flagged here, in the layer list and in Properties: they may look blurry or pixelated. 300 DPI is sharp up close, 150 DPI is usually fine for a panel; 0 turns the warning off
EXPORT_MIRROR_HINT: Flips the whole print, template lines and marks included, to print on the back of clear film or plexi and see it the right way through it
EXPORT_REGISTRATION_MARKS_HINT: Targets at the middle of each side of the outline's box, outside the bleed
EXPORT_RESOLUTION_HINT: For the PNG and the images in the PDF and SVG. A printer on Windows prints at its own resolution
EXPORT_SHEET_MARGIN_HINT: Blank border of each sheet, where the printer can't print and the marks go
EXPORT_SVG_HINT: Like the PDF, for a vector editor or a cutting machine: text, shapes and template lines stay vectors, each element's lines in a layer of its own; images are embedded
EXPORT_TILE_DRAG_HINT: Drag to move the sheets over the page
EXPORT_TILE_HINT: Prints a page larger than your paper on several sheets, to trim and join: one PDF page, and one PNG and SVG file per sheet
EXPORT_TILE_MARKS_HINT: In each sheet's margin: crop marks at the corners of its artwork, and ticks in line with the middle of each overlap, where one sheet is trimmed to line it up with the next
EXPORT_TILE_OVERLAP_HINT: Artwork printed on both neighboring sheets, so one can be trimmed and glued over the other without a gap
EXPORT_TILE_POSITION_HINT: Moves the sheets over the page, from centered: to keep the joins out of the buttons, for instance. Sheets are added or left out so the page stays covered. You can also drag them on the preview
FADE_CURVE_HINT: Opacity across the fade: opaque at the top left, where it starts, transparent at the bottom right, where it ends. Drag the two handles to shape it, as an easing curve in animation.
FILL_KIND_HINT: One color, or a gradient of several
FILTER_LINKED_JSON_PROJECT: Linked JSON project, images as separate files
FILTER_SHORTCUTS_HINT: Search a command or a key
FOLLOW_SYSTEM_THEME_HINT: Follow the operating system's light or dark setting
FONTS_NOT_INSTALLED:
These fonts are not installed, so their text is shown with the built-in font:
{fonts}
FORMULA_SYNTAX_ERROR: Not a valid formula: use numbers, variable names, + - * / and parentheses
FORMULA_WRONG_KIND: {name} can't be used here: this field takes {kind} and {number} variables
GRADIENT_ANGLE_HINT: Direction the colors run: 0° from left to right, 90° from bottom to top
GRADIENT_BAR_HINT: Click to add a color here. Drag a color below the bar to move it, right-click it to remove it.
GRADIENT_RADIUS_HINT: Where the last color is: 100% reaches the sides
GRADIENT_STOP_POSITION_HINT: Where this color is along the gradient
GROUP_LAYERS: Group: put the selection in a new group, or add an empty group
GROUP_OPACITY_HINT: Applied to the group as a whole
IMAGES_NOT_LOADED:
These images could not be loaded:
{files}
LAYER_BROKEN_LINKS_ONE: Linked to a variable that no longer exists: {names}
LAYER_BROKEN_LINKS_OTHER: Linked to {n} variables that no longer exist: {names}
LAYER_LOCKED_HINT: Locked: it can be selected but not moved or edited. Unlock it with the lock in the layer list.
LAYER_LOW_RESOLUTION: Prints at {dpi} DPI, below the {min} DPI set in the Export window: it may look blurry. Use a larger image, or print it smaller
LINKED_FIELD_HINT: Linked to {formula} = {value}. Click fx to edit the formula; type a number to unlink.
LOW_RESOLUTION_HINT: Below the {min} DPI set in the Export window: use a larger image, or print it smaller
MISSING_EFFECT_HINT:
"{id}" is not available: its plugin may not be installed.
It is kept in the project but not applied.
MOVE_LAYER_TO_BOTTOM: Send to the bottom of its group
MOVE_LAYER_TO_TOP: Bring to the top of its group
NIB_ANGLE_HINT: Angle of the calligraphy nib: drag around the wheel, double-click for 45°. The stroke is broadest across the nib, thinnest along it
NO_COMPATIBLE_VARIABLES: No variables of this kind yet: add one in the Variables section.
NO_LAYERS_YET: No layers yet. Add an image, a text or a shape with the first buttons below, or drop image files here.
NO_LAYER_SELECTED: Select a layer to edit it.
NO_TEMPLATES_FOUND: No controller templates found. Put a folder containing a .dxf file in a "templates" folder next to the program.
NO_TEMPLATE_CHOSEN: Choose a controller in the Controller panel to place its template here.
PAINT_COLOR_HINT: Color of the strokes painted next
PAINT_WIDTH_HINT: Width of the tool, in mm on the page
PANEL_DRAG_HINT: Drag to move the panel: onto a side of the window to dock it there, anywhere else to float it
PANEL_SPLITTER_HINT: Drag to resize the panels; double-click to give the panel above the height it needs
PREVIEW_BLEED_HINT: Show the cut preview with the bleed set in the Print panel: the holes smaller and the outline larger by it, as printed. Off, it follows the cut lines. The export always uses the bleed
PREVIEW_CUTS_HINT: Cover and hatch what is cut out of the panel: outside the outline and inside the button holes and cutouts, whether the export prints there or not
PREVIEW_SAFE_AREA_HINT: Show the safe area as a dashed guide on the canvas, the width set next to it inside the cut lines. Never printed
PRINT_FAILED_TO_FINISH: The printer did not accept the end of the document.
PRINT_FAILED_TO_SEND: A page could not be sent to the printer.
PRINT_FAILED_TO_START: The printer did not accept the document.
PRINT_NO_CUPS: Cannot run lp, to print through CUPS: {e}
PRINT_NO_PRINTERS: No printers found. Printing goes through CUPS: is it installed, with a printer set up?
PRINT_PAGE: Prints the page at true size on {paper} paper, {orientation}.
PRINT_SETTINGS_ELSEWHERE: Resolution, bleed, blank areas, marks and sheets: in the Print panel, for all projects.
PRINT_SETTINGS_SHARED: These settings are shared with Export, and saved with the project.
PRINT_SHEETS_ONE: Prints {n} sheet at true size on {paper} paper, {orientation}.
PRINT_SHEETS_OTHER: Prints {n} sheets ({cols} x {rows}) at true size on {paper} paper, {orientation}.
PRINT_SYSTEM_DIALOG_HINT: The printer, copies and paper are chosen next, in the system print dialog. Keep the scale at 100% so it prints at true size.
REMOVED_VARIABLE_USERS_ONE: It is used by {n} field or color, which keeps its current value and shows a broken link icon.
REMOVED_VARIABLE_USERS_OTHER: It is used by {n} fields and colors, which keep their current values and show a broken link icon.
REMOVE_GRADIENT_STOP: Remove this color (a gradient keeps two)
REMOVE_VARIABLE: Remove; the fields using it keep their value
RESCAN_TEMPLATES_HINT: Look again for templates added, changed or removed
RESET_LAYER_TRANSFORM_HINT: Fit inside the page, no rotation
RESET_SHORTCUT_TO_NONE: Back to no shortcut, as by default
SAFE_MARGIN_HINT: How far inside the outline and around the holes to keep text and important details, in mm. Saved with the project, never printed; 0 shows no guide
SAVED_WITH_MISSING_IMAGES:
Saved, but the image files of these layers are missing, so the saved project can't show them:
{layers}
SAVE_COLOR_AS_VARIABLE_HINT: Adds a color variable with this color and links this color to it
SAVE_COLOR_IN_USE: Double-click to save it as a color variable
SAVE_TEMPLATE_PLACEMENT_HINT: Write this placement into the template's template.json
SHAPE_EFFECT_SIZE_HINT: On the page; resizing the shape keeps it
SHAPE_INNER_RADIUS_HINT: Distance of the inner corners from the center, as a share of the points' distance
SHAPE_STRETCH_PAINT_HINT: On: resizing the shape stretches what is painted in it. Off: the paint stays where it is on the page, and the shape shows more or less of it.
SHAPE_STROKE_WIDTH_HINT: Width of the line along the outline, centered on it; resizing the shape keeps it
SHORTCUT_IN_USE: {shortcut} is already used by {command}: remove it there first.
SHORTCUT_KEPT_BY: {shortcut} is used by {command}, which keeps its keys.
SHOW_ELEMENT_LINES: Show its lines on the canvas
SNAP_TO_ANCHORS_HINT: Image centers, corners and edge middles snap to the template's anchors while dragged. Hold Alt to drag freely.
SNAP_TO_EDGES_HINT: While moved or resized, layer edges and centers snap to the page's edges and center, and to the template's outline: its edges, center, straight sides and bleed line. Hold Alt to drag freely.
SVG_LEFT_OUT: only shapes were imported; left out: {what}
SVG_TOO_MANY_SHAPES: only the first {count} shapes were imported
TEMPLATE_DOES_NOT_FIT: Template does not fit on this page
TEXT_EFFECT_SIZE_HINT: On the page; it follows the font size
TEXT_FALLBACK_FONTS_HINT: Characters the font lacks are taken from these fonts, saved with the project like the font itself.
TEXT_FONT_NOT_INSTALLED: This font is not installed: the text is shown with the built-in font.
TEXT_FONT_SIZE_HINT: Height of the letters; scaling the layer changes it
TEXT_LETTER_SPACING_HINT: In thousandths of the font size
TEXT_LINE_SPACING_HINT: Distance between lines, in font sizes
TEXT_MISSING_CHARACTERS: No installed font has these characters: {chars}
TEXT_ON_PATH_TYPE_HINT: Text on a path is typed here, not on the canvas.
TEXT_OUTLINE_HINT: Thickness of the line around the letters
TEXT_PATH_BEND_HINT: How much the lines bend: at 100 % the first line makes a whole circle; below 0 they bend down
TEXT_PATH_FLIP_HINT: Put the text on the other side of the path, running the other way: inside a circle, readable at its bottom
TEXT_PATH_POSITION_HINT: Where the text stands on the path, from its start (the top of a circle), as a share of its length. The text's alignment says which part of it stands there.
TEXT_PATH_RADIUS_HINT: Radius of the circle the first line's baseline follows. The layer is centered on the circle: snap its center to a button's anchor to put the text around the button.
TEXT_PATH_SHIFT_HINT: Distance from the path to the baseline, towards the top of the letters
TEXT_UNLINKED_BY_TYPING: Text typed in: no longer linked to the text variable {name}. Undo to link it again.
TYPE_ON_CANVAS_HINT: Or double-click the text on the canvas to type it there.
UNSAVED_CHANGES_WARNING: Your changes will be lost if you don't save them.
VARIABLES_EMPTY: No variables yet. Add one, then use it with a field's fx button, a color picker or a text's link button.
VARIABLE_NAME_INVALID: A name starts with a letter or _, then letters, digits or _, and is not used by another variable
